narrative_shape: A retry with an inherited dirty tree. 8 compactions by T75. After pytest 7/7 and a clean import grep (T75) it relaunches the heavy-lock disc check with a multiprocessing fix (T74-75). By T86 it diagnoses the runaway process as a memory-architecture problem (ShapeIndex.buckets is a defaultdict(list) of Python objects whose headers the GC keeps touching), reads walk.py/spool.py/quantisation_roundtrip.py repeatedly (5x, 4x, 3x) and issues three consecutive edits T87-89. Reads like a hard problem requiring redesign rather than a loop; T91-95 unseen.

phases.name: multiprocessing fix + relaunch
phases.note: T72-73 edits; T74 pytest; T75 relaunch heavy-lock check

early_signals.signal: Relaunches the heavy-lock check after a fix (a repeated launch)
Concludes runaway is a memory-architecture issue (defaultdict(list) of Python objects, GC)
quantisation_roundtrip.py 5x, walk.py 4x, spool.py 3x; three consecutive edits

rationale: Debug cycle with explicit root-cause statement and targeted edits; rereads accompany edits. High compaction and a repeated heavy run mean this is costly, but the pack shows reasoned iteration, not a mindless loop.
